_source: Danish Energy Agency, Technology Data for Energy Storage, datasheet version 0011, sheet '180 Lithium Ion Battery' (chapter updated May 2025). Workbook: https://ens.dk/media/6589/download (not redistributed)
_money: EUR2020 in the sheet (2024 prices deflated by 0.84, HICP); converted to EUR2025 with factor 1.217 (2020->2024 = 1/0.84, 2024->2025 ~ +2.2%, assumption)
_reference_unit: one 20-ft container, 3 MWh / 1.5 MW in 2025 (C-rate 0.5 rising to 2.0 by 2050); other project costs include construction, site cabling and contractor work
